title: 第14章 酒葫芦第15章 山洞
content_zh:
第14章酒葫芦
其他人也是大喜过望，因为他们得到了仙师的一个保证，虽然这个保证跟猛虎帮的不一样，只有令溪英仙师满意的情况下，他才会为大家指一条明路，可有了这个承诺，仙缘离他们还会远吗？猛虎帮也只是比他们获得了一个先手而已。
这溪英仙师不愧为师叔级的仙师，只是简单的一句话，既安抚了猛虎帮，也激励了西平府一众江湖人士，让他们有了奋斗目标，有了这个保证，这次密地之行谁还会不卖力气？
眼见下面的人士气正旺，那溪英仙师又道：“那处密地只有正午时分最容易进入，现在天色已晚，大家就在这里呆一晚，做一些准备工作，明天早上一起出发。”
吩咐完之后，那三名仙师没有再多说什么，闪身进入了山洞之中，至于外面的一行人，是没有资格到山洞里休息的。
猛虎帮似乎早有准备，带着众人又往旁边走了几十丈，在山壁下面找到了一处可以休息的地方。这是靠着山壁临时搭建的几座小木屋，虽然很简陋，却多少也能遮风挡雨。
大家都是江湖人士，早已习惯了风餐露宿，在进入山区之前，大家就按照猛虎帮的吩咐，各自准备了不少的干粮和咸肉干背在包袱里，以备不时之需。走了一天的路，所有人都是又累又饿，这时候直接拿出一些，就着河水填饱了肚子。
看看天色确实不早了，大家也就没有再浪费时间，各自找了地方休息。明天一大早就要进入那密地，这一次是福是祸很难预料，但危险是肯定有的，必须做好充分的准备，以免事到临头措手不及。
青阳与师父松鹤老道住在一起，两人特意挑选了一处最偏僻的小木屋，当然不是为了找机会逃走，先不说能不能逃出猛虎帮与仙师的双重监视，光是那仙师所承诺的明路，也没有人会舍得放弃，两人选在这里，只是习惯了低调，说话做事更方便一些。
小木屋地方不大，顶多有一丈见方，里面什么都没有，甚至连桌椅板凳都没有一张，只在地上铺着一些干草，这就是他们临时休息的床铺了。师父松鹤老道的心中似乎有什么心事，进去之后连一句话没有说话，直接找了一个角落闭目养神。
青阳也没有说话，乖巧的来到另外一边，和衣躺在了地上。他倒是也想早点入睡，可是这几天发生了这么多事情，尤其是今天又遇到了传说中的仙师，见证了不少超出以前认知的能力，这一幕幕在他心中来回的放映，让他难以入睡。
也不知过了多久，青阳迷迷糊糊的几乎就要睡着，忽然就听师父松鹤老道开口说道：“青阳徒儿过来！”
青阳顿时被惊醒，连忙起身来到松鹤老道的面前道：“师父，我在呢，你有什么事？”
“跪下！”松鹤道。
青阳不明所以，不过见师父如此郑重其事的样子，他也不敢多问，只好依言跪在了松鹤老道的面前。
松鹤老道也并没有多说什么，而是慢条斯理的结下自己腰上的那个硕大的酒葫芦托在手上，这才沉声道：“徒儿青阳听令，现在我以西平观第十六代观主的身份，任命你为西平观第十七代观主，这是观主的掌门信物，今天正式传承给你。”
松鹤老道把那酒葫芦递到了青阳的跟前，只是青阳一时没有反应过来，没有伸手去接，反而问道：“师父，你这是为何？”
松鹤老道没有回答他，而是继续盯着他，道：“你接还是不接？”
师父松鹤平时都是一副游戏风尘，不拘小节的样子，很多时候甚至跟徒弟斗嘴取乐，根本就不把那些伦理纲常放在心上。但是青阳也明白，一旦师父正经起来，那就是必须服从的时候，不能有丝毫的忤逆，青阳只好接过那酒葫芦，朝着松鹤老道拜下，道：“谨遵师命。”
见青阳接过了那酒葫芦，松鹤老道松了一口气，道：“这葫芦作为西平观的掌门信物已经传了很多代了，是什么来历我也不清楚，只知道他很不平凡，今天就把他和观主之位传给你，希望你以后能够弄清楚他的来历，光大我西平观。”

这个酒葫芦不平凡，青阳也是认同的，酒葫芦虽然一直在松鹤的手上，但是青阳小时候也没少拿着玩，甚至还拿这东西砸过核桃烧过水。如果是普通的葫芦，估计早就被玩坏了，但是这个葫芦却始终没有一丝损伤，不是宝物是什么？
但也仅仅如此，这酒葫芦除了很坚固的特性以外，就没有其他特别之处了，跟普通的葫芦一般无二，平时也只能拿来装酒。酒葫芦传到松鹤老道手中，经过了无数代，前前后后不知几百年，从来没有人发现别的用处，也没有引起过其他人的觊觎。
酒葫芦传给青阳是早晚的事，青阳也有这个心理准备，让他不能接受的是松鹤会在今天，选择这个时机传给自己。青阳如今也有十几岁了，很多事他都明白，若不是师父觉得这一次劫数难逃，又或者生死难料，怎么可能会做出这种举动？
青阳很明白师父的心思，明天他肯定会为自己争取不去那密地的机会，就算是不成功，进入密地之后也会处处护着自己，遇到了危险，师父肯定会先救徒弟，而把自己的安危放在最后。
以前闯荡江湖的时候松鹤老道就是这么做的，但世俗江湖只是普通人的世界，以师父松鹤老道的实力，有足够的把握在保护徒弟的同时避免自己的危险。但是这一次去的是未知的密地，其中的危险就不用说了，就连仙师都要寻找帮手，松鹤老道再也没有了以前的从容，只能提前把后事安排好。
师父师父，一日为师终身为父，两个人相依为命近十年，青阳早就把松鹤老道当成了自己父亲，当成自己唯一的亲人。如今眼见师父开示交代后事，青阳再也忍不住了，两行热泪不由得流了下来。
（本章完）
content_en:
Chapter 14 Wine Gourd
Others were also overjoyed because they received a guarantee from the Immortal Master. Although this guarantee was different from that of the Tiger Gang, only if the Immortal Master Xiying was satisfied would he point out a clear path for everyone. But with this promise, would immortality still be far away from them? The Tiger Gang just got a head start over them.
This Immortal Master Xi Ying is worthy of being an uncle-level Immortal Master. With just one simple sentence, he not only appeased the Tiger Gang, but also inspired all the people in the Xiping Prefecture, giving them a goal to strive for. With this guarantee, who would not work hard on this trip to the secret land?
Seeing that the people below were very popular, Immortal Master Naxi Yingxian added: "That secret place is easiest to enter at noon. It is getting late now, so everyone will stay here for one night, make some preparations, and set off together tomorrow morning."
After the instructions were given, the three immortal masters said nothing more and entered the cave. As for the group of people outside, they were not qualified to rest in the cave.
The Tiger Gang seemed to have been prepared. They led the group several dozen feet further to the side and found a place to rest under the mountain wall. These are a few temporary wooden huts built against the mountain wall. Although they are very simple, they can provide some protection from wind and rain.
We are all people from all walks of life, and have long been accustomed to eating and sleeping in the open. Before entering the mountainous area, everyone followed the instructions of the Tiger Gang and prepared a lot of dry food and dried bacon in their bags to prepare for emergencies. After walking for a day, everyone was tired and hungry. At this time, they took out some and filled their stomachs with the river water.
Seeing that it was indeed getting late, everyone didn't waste any more time and found a place to rest. We will enter the secret place early tomorrow morning. It is difficult to predict whether it will be a blessing or a disaster this time, but the danger is definitely there. We must be fully prepared to avoid being caught off guard when things happen.
Qingyang lived with his master, Songhe Laodao. The two of them deliberately chose the most remote cabin. Of course, they were not looking for a chance to escape. Not to mention whether they could escape the double surveillance of the Tiger Gang and the Immortal Master. No one was willing to give up just the clear path promised by the Immortal Master. The two of them chose this place because they were used to keeping a low profile and it was easier to talk and do things.
The cabin was not big, only one foot square at most. There was nothing in it, not even a table, chair or bench. There was only some hay spread on the ground, which served as a temporary bed for them to rest. Master Songhe Laodao seemed to have something on his mind. After entering, he didn't even say a word and just found a corner to close his eyes and rest.
Qingyang didn't say anything, and obediently came to the other side and lay on the ground fully clothed. He wanted to go to bed early, but so many things had happened in the past few days, especially today when he met the legendary immortal master and witnessed many abilities beyond his previous knowledge. The scenes played back and forth in his mind, making it difficult for him to fall asleep.
I don’t know how long it took, but Qingyang was almost asleep when he suddenly heard his master, Taoist Songhe, say: "Disciple Qingyang, come here!"
Qingyang was suddenly awakened. He quickly stood up and came to Songhe Laodao and said, "Master, I'm here. What can I do for you?"
"Kneel down!" Songhe said.
Qingyang didn't know why, but when he saw his master acting so solemnly, he didn't dare to ask any more questions, so he had no choice but to kneel in front of Old Taoist Songhe as he was told.
Old Taoist Songhe did not say much, but slowly knotted the huge wine gourd on his waist and held it in his hand, and then said in a deep voice: "Disciple Qingyang, please listen. Now, as the sixteenth generation temple master of Xiping Temple, I appoint you as the seventeenth generation temple master of Xiping Temple. This is the temple master's token, and it will be officially passed on to you today."
Master Songhe handed the wine gourd to Qingyang, but Qingyang didn't react for a moment and didn't reach out to take it. Instead, he asked: "Master, why are you doing this?"? "
Old Taoist Songhe did not answer him, but continued to stare at him and said: "Are you going to answer or not? "
Master Songhe usually behaves like a gamer and does not stick to trivial matters. Many times he even bickers with his disciples for fun, and does not take those ethical principles to heart at all. But Qingyang also understood that once the master became serious, that was the time when he had to obey without any disobedience. Qingyang had no choice but to take the wine gourd, bow to Songhe Lao Dao, and said: "I will obey the master's order. "
Seeing Qingyang taking the wine gourd, Taoist Songhe breathed a sigh of relief and said: "This gourd has been passed down for many generations as a token of the master of Xiping Temple. I don't know its origin. I only know that he is very extraordinary. Today I pass on him and the position of the temple master to you. I hope you can figure out his origin in the future and help us to glorify Xiping Temple." "
This wine gourd is extraordinary, and Qingyang also agrees. Although the wine gourd has always been in Songhe's hand, Qingyang used it to play with it when he was a child. He even used it to smash walnuts and boil water. If it were an ordinary gourd, it would have been damaged long ago, but this gourd has never been damaged at all. What is it if it's not a treasure?
But that's all. Apart from being very sturdy, this wine gourd has no other special features. It is just like an ordinary gourd and can only be used to hold wine. The wine gourd has been passed down to Songhe Lao Dao for countless generations and hundreds of years. No one has ever discovered any other uses for it, and it has never aroused other people's covetousness.
It was only a matter of time before the wine gourd was passed on to Qingyang. Qingyang was also mentally prepared for this. What he couldn't accept was that Songhe would choose this time to pass it on to him today. Qingyang is now a teenager, and he understands many things. If the master hadn't felt that this time was inevitable, or that life and death were unpredictable, how could he have done such a thing?
Qingyang understands his master's thoughts very well. He will definitely fight for himself the chance not to go to the secret place tomorrow. Even if he fails, he will protect himself at all times after entering the secret place. When encountering danger, the master will definitely save his apprentice first and put his own safety last.
This is what Songhe Laodao did when he was traveling in the world in the past, but the secular world is just a world for ordinary people. With the strength of his master, Songhe Laodao, he is confident enough to protect his disciples while avoiding his own danger. But this time we went to an unknown secret place, and needless to say there were dangers there. Even the immortal master had to look for helpers. Songhe Taoist no longer had the calmness he had before, so he had to make arrangements for his funeral in advance.
Master, master, once a master, always a father. The two have been dependent on each other for nearly ten years. Qingyang has long regarded Songhe Laodao as his father and his only relative. Now seeing his master's instructions on his funeral arrangements, Qingyang could no longer hold back, and two lines of hot tears could not help but flow down.
(End of chapter)
